protocol.purpose: Controlled retrospective daily MODIS-to-SNPP comparison: architecture versus spatial/temporal context
protocol.supervision: California only; all models use identical daily target rows and quality policy
protocol.context: MODIS within union of five previously prepared western states; +/-3 days, +/-2 grid cells. Center uses state-clipped California measurements. Outside-domain, listed missing days, and dates outside each split have an explicit availability mask and zero-filled values. Availability is not clear-sky exposure.
protocol.quality: Evaluate complete paired months only using the original NASA outage policy. Context does not cross split boundaries. All days of an eligible target month are retained.
protocol.calfire: Never a predictor or target. Link records by normalized IRWIN/complex IDs; purge training inputs/labels spatially and temporally associated with a linked event that also touches the audit period. Use final perimeters for descriptive large-event strata only. Missing linkage/dates preclude a guarantee of event independence.
protocol.neural_fit: AdamW lr 0.001, weight_decay 0.001, batch 2048, CPU threads 4. Small 8-filter spatial convolution over daily channels; residual positive count mean anchored to training seasonal ratio. NB2 learns one global dispersion. Aggregate variant adds 0.1 times squared log1p monthly north/south aggregate disagreement, computed on full eligible train month batches.
protocol.boost: HistGradientBoosting Poisson, 100 iterations, learning rate .05, max_leaf_nodes 15, min_samples_leaf 100, l2 10, no early stopping. Exposure-weighted baseline-offset target.
protocol.sampling: Keep all training rows with local MODIS>0 or VIIRS>0 and a seeded 10% sample of double-zero rows; inverse-probability weights. Same rows for all architectures. Full unsampled evaluation. Monthly aggregate training uses all unpurged rows, not sampled estimates.
protocol.selection_rule: Select epoch for each NN family using ensemble statewide monthly MAE on 2019-2020 only. Refit 2013-2020 with chosen epochs, ensemble three seeds. Select final family by 2021-2022 statewide monthly MAE. Baseline wins ties. Known benchmark and backward audit are computed only after saving selection.
protocol.promotion: Research comparison only; no automatic production change. Report selection cell MAE, north/south monthly MAE, zero-MODIS-daily and zero-MODIS-month strata and >=500 MODIS/month errors alongside primary MAE.
protocol.limitations: All historical evaluation periods have already been inspected. This is an exploratory follow-up, not a pristine independent test. Full observation masks remain unavailable as predictors. Grid and context size are fixed for this first experiment; no benchmark-driven tuning.

manifest.monthly_parity_with_v2: passed for every full reference month 2012-02 through 2025-12
limitations: Availability channel measures source/split support, not overpass/cloud exposure.
Context outside the five-state union is unavailable.
Monthly outage exclusions are conservative and shared with v2.
